## Summary

Describe the user-visible or operational change.

## Verification

- [ ] Backend tests pass, or the change does not affect the backend.
- [ ] Frontend tests and production build pass, or the change does not affect the frontend.
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, private identifiers, or sensitive URLs are included.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when behavior or setup changes.

## Risk

Describe security, compatibility, migration, or rollout considerations.
